title: Level 3 Art History — Meanings in Art Works 2025
subject: art-history

questions.text:
Answer ONE question. Select and name TWO art works from the resource booklet or your own choice. Answer BOTH parts of your chosen question.

You will choose a question that focuses on specific meanings communicated through the features of art works. Explain how the meanings are conveyed through the features of the two named art works, and make clear connections between the meanings and the features of the art works.

Aim for a concise response of no more than 5-6 pages. The quality of your writing is more important than the length of your answer.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4 marks): Examine involves explaining the meanings and how these are conveyed through the features of art works. It is the connection between the meanings and how they are conveyed that is the key focus. The candidate explains appropriate meanings conveyed through features in two named art works, and indicates some connections between the meanings and how they are conveyed. The candidate makes clear connections between the meanings and features in each art work. Merit (5-6 marks): Examine in depth involves providing a coherent and considered explanation of the meanings and how the meanings are conveyed through the features of art works. The candidate provides a considered explanation of the meanings conveyed through features in two named art works, and makes clear connections between meanings and features. The candidate explains the connections between these meanings and how they are conveyed through the features. A typical coherent response will directly address the selected question with an informed explanatory discussion of appropriate meanings, using relevant art historical terminology. Excellence (7-8 marks): Examine perceptively involves explaining how and why meanings are constructed and conveyed through the features of art works, with reference to relevant contextual factors. The candidate uses relevant contextual information to support perceptive explanations of how and why meanings are constructed and conveyed through the features of two named art works. Perceptive understanding will be apparent in the candidate's fluent and comprehensive knowledge of their selected area(s) of study. A typical response will directly address all aspects of the selected question with an in-depth contextualised discussion.
